bio:
I am a Computer Science student specializing in Python, Django, and Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, with a strong focus on building clean, scalable, and practical applications.

I enjoy developing full-stack web applications, working on AI/ML-based systems, and turning ideas into real, usable solutions. My experience includes backend development with Django, frontend design using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and implementing machine learning models for prediction, analysis, and automation.

I am passionate about writing structured, maintainable code, improving system performance, and continuously learning new technologies. Through hands-on projects, I aim to create applications that are reliable, efficient, and user-focused.
